title: 東京灣跨海公路隧道~Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel
focus: 人工島接合、海底盾構與長期鹽害~Island interfaces, subsea shield drives and marine durability
summary: 東京灣跨海公路結合海底隧道、人工島與橋梁，大林組工程史列整體道路15.1公里及1997年施工標竣工。本課把整體走廊與承包商施工範圍分開，聚焦人工島支承、地下接合、環片與止水、通風和鹽害；不把某一標段紀錄泛化為整個工程所有部位的參數。~The Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line combines a subsea tunnel, artificial islands and a bridge. Obayashi records a 15.1 km road corridor and completion of its contract in 1997. The course separates corridor and contract scope, focusing on island support, underground connections, segments, sealing, ventilation and marine deterioration without generalising one contract to every structure.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.16 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.16 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 大直徑海底盾構的切削與環片物流互相制約，教材以Aqua-Line背景區分單次高進尺與整班利用率。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Large-diameter cutting and segment logistics interact; distinguish high short-duration advance from whole-shift utilisation in the Aqua-Line setting. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.77 m/h；有效利用率=0.28 無因次。D=24vu=11.8944 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.0838 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.77 m/h; utilisation=0.28 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.8944 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.0838 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把環片到場、拼裝和切削時間對齊，找真正瓶頸。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align segment delivery, erection and cutting times to identify the bottleneck. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 提高切削速度但環片供應不足只會增加等待。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Faster cutting with inadequate segment supply merely increases waiting. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：把環片到場、拼裝和切削時間對齊，找真正瓶頸。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align segment delivery, erection and cutting times to identify the bottleneck. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.anchor: 襯砌背後幾何空隙~Geometric lining annulus
units.title: 背填連續性與體積帳~Backfill continuity and volume balance
units.mechanism: 海底環片背填需填補幾何空隙，教學體積不能當實際灌漿完成量，因為地層吸收和超挖仍未知。盾尾空隙須由背填恢復襯砌與地層的接觸，但幾何空隙不是必然注入量。超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。~Backfill fills geometric voids, but teaching volume cannot prove completion because ground take and overbreak remain uncertain. Backfill restores contact across the shield-tail gap, but geometric void is not the required injected volume. Overbreak, absorption, return and material volume change alter the balance. Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total.
units.model: 原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.36 m；襯砌外徑=8.06 m；環長=1.5 m。V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³。僅把環長增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.38364 m³。邊界：同心幾何空隙，不等於實際灌漿需求或完成證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.38364 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。用環片及開挖尺寸計算幾何空隙，核對注入回流質量與時間戳，再以適當無損檢測及變形資料查局部缺填。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。~Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage.
units.misconception: 灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。~Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.12914 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.12914 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 止水壓縮餘量~Gasket compression reserve
units.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡~Joint compression and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 大林組記載接合與防水措施，本課以假想接縫研究幾何容許與實際水密試驗的差別。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。~Using documented connection and waterproofing context, a hypothetical joint distinguishes geometric allowance from actual pressure-test performance. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將錯台、張開和水壓組合試驗與現場幾何配對。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Match combined offset, opening and pressure tests with field geometry. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只查止水材料證明未必涵蓋現場接合位移組合。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。~Material certification alone may not cover the installed displacement combination. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.
units.misconception: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。~An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
units.practice: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：將錯台、張開和水壓組合試驗與現場幾何配對。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Match combined offset, opening and pressure tests with field geometry. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 從不同人工島相向掘進的控制網需獨立覆核，研究水下接合前方向和高程不確定性。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Opposing drives from separate islands need independent control checks before underwater connection, including direction and height uncertainty. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4080 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0565719 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=4080 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0565719 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩端共用尺度錯誤可能在長距離累積而未被局部閉合發現。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Shared scale error accumulates over long drives without appearing in local closure. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷梯度~Differential settlement gradient
units.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角~Bedding movement and joint rotation
units.mechanism: 人工島填築地盤與海底孔連接形成差異沉陷課題，研究工後固結如何傳到柔性接合。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。~Reclaimed island ground creates differential settlement at the tunnel connection; examine how postconstruction consolidation reaches flexible interfaces. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
units.model: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=5 mm；基線長度=170 m。β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0323529 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=5 mm; baseline=170 m. β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0323529 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只追蹤隧道中心高程會漏掉島體一側持續下沉。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。~Tunnel-centre elevation alone misses continuing settlement on the island side. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.
units.misconception: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。~Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
units.practice: 本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 海上通風設施與隧道內阻力構成共同網路，研究外風改變時風機工況點的移動。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Offshore ventilation structures and tunnel resistance form one network; examine operating-point changes under external wind. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=860 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=46.569 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為56.3485 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=860 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=46.569 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 56.3485 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步記錄外風、風機狀態與孔內壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise external wind, fan state and tunnel pressure difference. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步記錄外風、風機狀態與孔內壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise external wind, fan state and tunnel pressure difference. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 擴散特徵長度~Diffusion characteristic length
units.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀~Chloride transport and durability interpretation
units.mechanism: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。~Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為36.3195 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 36.3195 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。~A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.
units.misconception: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。~Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
units.practice: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。~For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate joint compression and sealing envelope. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1997 年公開記錄：東京灣跨海公路的隧道施工標於12月竣工。東京灣跨海公路結合海底隧道、人工島與橋梁，大林組工程史列整體道路15.1公里及1997年施工標竣工。本課把整體走廊與承包商施工範圍分開，聚焦人工島支承、地下接合、環片與止水、通風和鹽害；不把某一標段紀錄泛化為整個工程所有部位的參數。本課把「人工島接合、海底盾構與長期鹽害」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1997: The documented Aqua-Line tunnel construction contract is completed in December. The Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line combines a subsea tunnel, artificial islands and a bridge. Obayashi records a 15.1 km road corridor and completion of its contract in 1997. The course separates corridor and contract scope, focusing on island support, underground connections, segments, sealing, ventilation and marine deterioration without generalising one contract to every structure. The course treats island interfaces, subsea shield drives and marine durability as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 15.1 km whole road corridor，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 15.1 km whole road corridor; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1997 年事件：東京灣跨海公路的隧道施工標於12月竣工。~1997 event: The documented Aqua-Line tunnel construction contract is completed in December.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=15.6 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=15.6 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=15.6 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 15.6 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=657.27 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 657.27 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=4.66286 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 4.66286 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「止水壓縮餘量」：初始壓縮=19 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=13 mm；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching gasket compression reserve: initial compression=19 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 13 mm; not measured or accepted project data.
